name: Mateo Rodriguez
bio: Mateo's passion for motorsport ignited during his childhood, fueled by his grandfather's tales of Juan Manuel Fangio's legendary victories. He pursued a degree in engineering, specializing in vehicle dynamics, before transitioning to a junior strategist role with a small touring car team. His meticulous approach and data-driven insights quickly gained attention, leading to a series of promotions and a reputation for optimizing race strategies under pressure. Mateo thrives on the challenge of predicting opponent moves and adapting to changing track conditions, always striving for that elusive perfect race.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight wave
physical.description: Mateo is of average height with a focused gaze and a lean build.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten notes and calculations.
Insists on listening to tango music before every race to calm his nerves.
Obsessively cleans his workstation before and after each session.
